posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal's baby boy Vihaan Kaushal's first photo has been released, with Kareena Kapoor welcoming Katrina to the 'Mamma Club' amid an outpouring of love from fans.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali hits theaters June 12 as he continues his AURA Tour 2026 worldwide — after debuting the trailer at a packed Toronto concert and selling out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia kicks off Alpha promotions with Sharvari Wagh ahead of its July 3 release — the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film — while also championing the Indian Women's Cricket Team for the T20 World Cup.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into filming SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' (₹1,300 crore) with Mahesh Babu, confirming six months of shooting still remain for the epic action-adventure spanning multiple continents.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's 'King' is confirmed for Christmas 2026 — a ₹350 crore action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand, featuring daughter Suhana Khan's big-screen debut alongside Abhishek Bachchan as the antagonist.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo is gearing up for 'Daayra' with director Meghna Gulzar, a gritty thriller co-starring Prithviraj Sukumaran — continuing her pivot toward intense, content-driven cinema after The Buckingham Murders.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha remains Bollywood's reigning horror-comedy queen after Stree 2's blockbuster success, with fans eagerly awaiting announcements about her next big-screen outing.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is set to reunite with SRK in 'King' for Christmas 2026, marking their sixth collaboration, while Sai Pallavi has been confirmed as her replacement in the Kalki sequel.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar 2 — the second-highest-grossing Indian film of all time at ₹1,800 crore worldwide — drops on JioHotstar today, while he battles FWICE in court over a non-cooperation directive stemming from his Don 3 exit.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya continues to maintain her regal presence in the public eye, with fans speculating about her next project as she remains one of Bollywood's most followed personalities globally.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika reunites with Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi spectacle 'Raaka' — but this time as the villain, playing her most daring role yet after completing look tests and body scans in LA.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is headlining 'Maa Inti Bangaram,' a female-centric action thriller directed by Nandini Reddy, while also expanding into production as she enters 2026 focused on purpose-driven choices.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is filming 'Raaka' with director Atlee — a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle featuring multiple roles, alongside Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, and Janhvi Kapoor in a star-studded ensemble.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' storms into theaters today — the sports action drama opened to ₹51 crore net in India and ₹112 crore worldwide, with AR Rahman's background score earning massive praise.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is set to reunite with director Trivikram for a mythological film about Kartikeya, while 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel is locked for June 2027 — keeping his fans buzzing with a packed slate.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in 'Peddi,' which hit theaters today to a massive opening — she also has a reunion with Varun Dhawan in Shashank Khaitan's upcoming romantic comedy.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya has been turning heads at Mumbai events with stunning ethnic looks, and was among the Bollywood stars spotted at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre celebrations.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in the highly anticipated War 2, confirmed for IMAX release on August 14 with a ₹400 crore budget — the biggest YRF spy film yet.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 with Jr NTR is locked for August 14 in IMAX — the ₹400 crore spy thriller has its trailer racking up 55 million YouTube views in 24 hours as anticipation hits fever pitch.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with David Dhawan releases tomorrow (June 5) — the first major Bollywood release post-IPL, co-starring Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya dropped her heartfelt new song 'Siddha Bhajo' on June 1 — a rendition her late father always wished for — and is gearing up for The Unstoppable Tour hitting Australia, Singapore, and a massive US/Canada run this fall.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's score for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' is getting rave reviews as the film hits theaters today, while he also co-produces 'Masoom: The New Generation' with Shekhar Kapur and mentors emerging artists through JBL Music Academy 2026.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film 'Jana Nayagan' is eyeing a July 2026 release window after its January debut was delayed — the ₹500 crore+ KVN Productions epic marks his grand exit from cinema as he pivots to politics.
